subject: Golden orb
topic: In twenty twenty-three, NOAA found a mysterious golden orb, more than three kilometers deep near Alaska.
script:
In twenty twenty-three, NOAA found a mysterious golden orb, more than three kilometers deep near Alaska.
It was stuck to a rock, smooth and shiny, with a small hole in its side.
The video went viral, and people everywhere guessed what it could be.
An egg? A sponge? Something completely new?
The team carefully collected it with a suction tool and brought it to the surface.
Then it was sent to experts at the Smithsonian's natural history museum.
In twenty twenty-six, they finally had an answer.
The golden orb was once part of the base of a giant deep-sea anemone.
What did you think it was?
pkg_title: The Mysterious GOLDEN ORB Has Finally Been Identified 🟡 #Shorts
